_about: End-launch connector and layout data for the coupons (validation/test_board/README.md). Dimensions in mm. make_coupons.py generates the connector footprint from 'footprint' (Samtec's drawing; DRAFT until checked) and the launch from 'launch' (parametric, to be optimised); edit the values here and regenerate (make_coupons.py --reuse-design).

connector.what: 50 Ω 2.92 mm (K) jack, edge launch, solderless compression mount (field replaceable), PCB thickness .040-.100 in (1.02-2.54 mm, option -01), 2 × #1-72 SHCS with #1 split washers, torque 0.5-0.8 in-lb; air dielectric; intermates with 3.5 mm and SMA
connector.decision: maintainer, 2026-10-30, on the RF group's advice (2.92 mm to 40 GHz instead of SMA): in stock at DigiKey (maintainer, 2026-10-30), also Mouser, the -01 thickness range covers every board (1.55-2.05 mm), solderless and reusable
connector.replaces: Southwest Microwave 292-04A-14 (SMA, 27 GHz; design v2, 2026-10-22): not orderable from DigiKey / Mouser

price_usd.src: samtec.com product page, OEM price, fetched 2026-10-30

quantity.note: 2 per 2-port coupon, 4 for the 4-port (pair, coupling) coupons; the connectors move between coupons. A fifth as a spare, a sixth to leave THRU mounted for the repeatability check (optional).

connector.pcb_fasteners: 2 × #1-72 SHCS with #1 split washer (on the drawing: whether they come with the part is to be confirmed); 1/16 in hex key

torque_in_lb.src: drawing note 1 (screws); 2.92 mm mating torque as for SMA / 3.5 mm (8 in-lb, 0.9 N·m)

connector.pin_note: drawing (sheet 1, details A and B): launch pin Ø.007 in [0.18] in a Ø.0276 in [0.70] opening of the front lip, .029 in [0.74] beyond the reference plane B (the board edge). Samtec's 3D model (used locally, not in the repository): pin axis 0.13 mm above the board surface, the pin ends 0.69 mm from the edge

sources.product: https://www.samtec.com/products/292-j-p-ep-st-el-01 (fetched 2026-10-30: 50 Ω, performance to 40 GHz, compression mount, price; 3D model, prints and footprint only in the email 'Specs Kit')
sources.drawing: Samtec drawing 292-J-P-EP-ST-EL-01-X-MKT, rev C, 2022-01-10 (sheet 1 part, sheet 2 'recommended footprint'); https://suddendocs.samtec.com/prints/292-j-p-ep-st-el-01-x-mkt.pdf - supplied by the maintainer 2026-10-30, not in the repository
sources.test_report: Samtec RF Characterization Report, series 292, 292-J-P-EP-ST-EL-01, report revision 2023-06-01 (tested 2023-03), https://suddendocs.samtec.com/testreports/20230601_t-3691751_rfc_292-j-p-ep-st-el-01.pdf - not in the repository
sources.footprint_model: SnapMagic KiCad footprint SAMTEC_292-J-P-EP-ST-EL-01 and CADENAS STEP 292-J-P-EP-ST-EL-01 (supplied by the maintainer 2026-10-30; their licences forbid redistributing the models, so they are not in the repository - make_coupons.py generates the footprint from the parameters below)

connector.body_on_board: Samtec's 3D model (CADENAS STEP, used locally, not redistributed): the top jaw covers the board 5.08 mm from the edge, 9.53 mm wide; a front lip 0.38 mm deep with the pin opening, then a slot over the trace 2.67 mm wide (0.38-0.64 mm) and 3.18 mm wide (0.64-5.08 mm, open to the top); the lower plate 8.89 × 5.33 mm clamps the bottom side; screws at 2.79 mm from the edge, ±2.92 mm

step_model._about: Geometry of Samtec's 3D model (CADENAS STEP 292-J-P-EP-ST-EL-01, supplied by the maintainer 2026-10-30, NOT in the repository: its terms forbid redistributing it), measured with gmsh 4.15 / OpenCASCADE on 2026-10-31 for cst_launch.py (which imports the STEP itself and uses these values to split, cut and place it). mm, STEP coordinates: x along the connector axis from the front face of the thread (x = 0) towards the board, y up (the board normal; the jaw is on top), z across; the coax axis is y = z = 0. The STEP has 7 solids in 5 parts and no materials.

parts.name: S-PRF92-J-P-EP-ST-EL-01
parts.what: body, bushing and both jaws as ONE solid (stainless steel, drawing); it also contains the support bead and fills the space around the contact between the bead and the front lip (below)

parts.name: PRF92-J-P-2E-ST-EL-SK-01
parts.what: centre contact: slotted socket, stepped body and the launch pin as one solid (BeCu, gold, drawing)

step_model.mating_plane_note: outer-conductor face (annulus Ø2.92-Ø4.61 mm); drawing: REF PLANE .075 in [1.91] behind the front, .380 in [9.66] to the board edge (model: 9.60); the socket starts 0.038 mm behind it (pin-depth recession)

oc_bore.note: Ø2.92 mm air line in front of the bead (60 ln(2.921/1.270) = 50.0 Ω with the Ø1.27 contact)

contact: socket: 4 fingers (slots 0.127 mm), bore Ø0.95 mm to x = 4.76
groove in the bead's centre hole
launch pin Ø0.178, ends 0.686 mm beyond the board edge

bead.note: a disc Ø2.92 × 1.27 mm with six Ø0.70 mm holes on Ø2.01 mm and a Ø0.91 mm centre hole; part of the body solid (no solid or material of its own); the contact's Ø1.27 shoulder overlaps it by 0.38 mm (x 5.105-5.486)

filled.note: no bore in the model: the body solid overlaps the contact here (3.46 mm³), so the inside of the connector between the bead and the front lip is not modelled; cst_launch.py cuts a bore of assumed impedance (--cavity-z, --cavity-er)

step_model.board_edge_note: front of the lower plate; screw axes at x = 14.326 (2.794 from it, as the drawing), z = ±2.921
step_model.board_top_note: underside of the jaw: the pin axis is 0.127 mm above the board, the pin's underside 0.038 mm above it (the real pin is pressed onto the pad: drawing detail A, .0025 in)
step_model.board_bottom_note: top of the lower plate (the model shows a 1.905 mm board); the plate has a 0.51 × 0.08 mm groove under the trace
step_model.body_shape_note: outside: 1/4-36 thread Ø6.35 (relief Ø5.36 at x 4.83-5.63), hex Ø9.53 across the corners x 5.63-6.83, then the Ø9.53 cylinder cut flat at y = ±3.975 (jaw top y = 1.778 from x = 11.66); cst_launch.py --connector parametric: Ø6.35 to the hex, Ø9.53 after it, clipped to ±clip_body

benchmark.fixture: PCB-240MM-112613-SIG-0, 4 layers Isola I-Tera MT40 (εr 3.45, tan δ 0.0031 at 10 GHz for the 3.45 grade: https://www.isola-group.com/pcb-laminates-prepreg/i-tera-mt40-rf-mw/), 50 Ω grounded-coplanar trace, launch optimised with a full-wave solver; PNA N5227B 10 MHz-40 GHz, Maury 8770CK 2.92 mm mechanical cal at the cable ends
benchmark.note: target for our launch on FR-4 7628: |S11| below -20 dB to 40 GHz for one launch; expect more line loss than MT40 (tan δ 0.02 vs 0.003)

cst_model._about: cst_launch.py --model samtec_bench: a plausibility check against the report, NOT Samtec's fixture (its stackup, trace and launch are not published). Assumed: 4 layers I-Tera MT40 (εr 3.45, tan δ 0.0031, Isola data sheet for the 3.45 grade at 10 GHz), 0.254 mm (10 mil) L1-L2 (Samtec's 0.52 mm footprint pad is about 50 Ω on 10 mil of εr 3.45), 1.0 mm core, 0.254 mm L3-L4, 1 oz outer / 0.5 oz inner copper, no solder mask; a 50 Ω grounded coplanar line from the edge to the edge (w 0.50 mm, gap 0.30 mm: 49.9 Ω with kisi's field solver, 2026-10-31), our launch shape (the line width to the edge, fence 0.55 mm), no row walls

stackup.title: Isola I-Tera MT40 4 layers 1.6 mm (ASSUMED for the Samtec benchmark, cst_launch.py)

footprint.warning: generated by make_coupons.py from these parameters; the geometry follows Samtec's drawing 292-J-P-EP-ST-EL-01-X-MKT rev C (sheet 2) and the SnapMagic footprint. Samtec calls it a general footprint, not optimised for electrical performance: the launch inside it (connectors.json 'launch') is ours and still to be optimised in kisi-fdtd; confirm with SIG@samtec.com if needed
footprint.name: Samtec_292-J-P-EP-ST-EL-01_EdgeLaunch
footprint.edge_pullback_src: JLCPCB: copper >= 0.2 mm from routed edges (capabilities page). Samtec's footprint runs copper to the edge: the pin still rests 0.54 mm on the pad, the front lip 0.18 mm on the ground fingers (open point: ask JLC for less)
footprint.mount_holes_note: x from the board edge into the board, y across; plated, GND
footprint.hole_ring_note: round pad of the plated holes on every copper layer (SnapMagic anchor Ø2.7 mm); the ground pads themselves only on the top and bottom copper, where the jaws clamp (Samtec's footprint has them on every layer: on the inner layers our GND planes do that job, and PWR islands stay clear)

gnd_pad.note: ground pad outline per side (x from the edge, y from the centreline): outer edge at half_width up to chamfer_start, 45° to (depth, chamfer_half_width), back edge at depth, inner edge at inner_half down to the fingers (x, y) that reach towards the signal at the edge

footprint.bottom_contact_note: the lower plate clamps the bottom side: the ground pads are on every copper layer (as in Samtec's footprint), mask open on both sides
footprint.body_note: body 9.53 mm wide (.375), 5.08 mm over the board, 11.57 mm outside (bushing Ø6.35); courtyard ±5.51 mm, 6.73 mm on the board, 11.82 mm outside (SnapMagic)

launch._about: The launch inside the Samtec ground pads, parametric for the optimisation (README section 2). mm, x from the board edge. null = the stackup's designed 50 Ω launch (boards/<stackup>.design.json 'launch': w, gap, and the plane opening of the thin-prepreg boards). Sections: tip (tip_w at the edge, Samtec 0.23 mm) tapering to pad_w at taper_len, pad (pad_w, gap pad_gap) to pad_len, grounded coplanar launch (w, gap) to launch_length, then the coupon's 50 Ω line. The top ground is the union of the Samtec ground pads and the coplanar pours.
launch.status: DRAFT – first kisi-fdtd optimisation step (2026-10-30, README section 2): launch width to the edge (no tip), fence 0.55 mm from 0.5 mm; board side only, the connector's coax / pin / jaw not yet in the model
launch.pad_w_min_note: the narrowest launch the design may give (the thin-prepreg (3313) launch, design v2 value, kept); the pin (Ø0.18 mm) lands on the tip

samtec_general.note: Samtec's general footprint: 0.52 mm signal between the ground pads (1.19 mm gap): 43.5 Ω on the 0.21 mm 7628 prepreg (kisi field solver; 115 Ω with In1 cut out 1.12 mm wide under it); a sweep point

launch.launch_length_note: the depth of the ground pads

gnd_cut.note: opening in the first plane under the tip / pad (width across, length from the edge); null = none (7628), or the design's opening along the whole launch (3313 thin prepreg)

fence.note: fence vias along both coplanar gaps: columns from first_x every pitch to launch_length - 0.35, rows offset from the gap edge; none within hole_keep of a screw hole's copper. 0.55 mm (hole-to-hole 0.25 mm, the board's DRC minimum) removes the |S21| dips of the 0.8 mm draft at 25-38 GHz

launch.tip_w_note: null = the launch width to the edge (best in the board-side kisi-fdtd runs: -21.0 dB worst to 40 GHz); Samtec's footprint narrows the tip to 0.229 mm (-15.7 dB, with the pin modelled -16.8 dB): a sweep point until the connector is in the model

layout.row_pitch_note: 2-port coupons: one connector per edge per row, one row connected at a time; 12.0 mm leaves 3.1 mm between two .350 in blocks (1.5 mm between the .414 in courtyards) and fits four rows on a 50 mm board
layout.pair_pitch_note: 4-port coupons: two connectors per edge 12.7 mm apart (3.8 mm between blocks, about 3.5 mm between the 5/16 in (7.94 mm) coupling nuts across their corners: check torque-wrench access; --pair-pitch changes it)
layout.feed_note: board edge to the reference plane of every 2-port coupon (half of the 25 mm 2xthru)
layout.feed_4port_note: 4-port coupons: the fan-in from the connector pitch to the 1.0 mm via pitch needs room; their own pair 2xthru has the same 15 mm
layout.via_line_note: via-line-via coupons: length of the line on the far layer between the two transitions (TDR separates the two vias: about 60 ps round trip)
layout.return_line_note: the same for the return-path (D) coupons, so the two reference changes interact less
layout.wall_pitch_note: v3: 1.27 mm (was 2.54): GND via walls between rows must stay closed to 40 GHz; a 2.54 mm pitch is λ/2 in FR-4 near 28 GHz, 1.27 mm near 56 GHz
layout.via_src: JLCPCB capabilities: via hole >= 0.15 mm, annular ring >= 0.15 mm; inner-layer hole-to-copper >= 0.2 mm (antipad of a 0.3 mm via >= 0.7 mm); via hole-to-hole >= 0.2 mm
layout.board_limits_note: maintainer's cost limits (2026-10-22): JLC 1-4 layers 100 x 100 mm and 6-8 layers 50 x 50 mm (JLC 'promo size', 5 pcs from 2 USD: https://jlcpcb.com/ads/pcb-manufacturer-comparison, fetched 2026-10-22)

parts._about: SMD land patterns (KiCad standard library geometry, reflow): pitch = pad centre distance, pad = size along / across the part axis. kisi derives the package from the pitch (crates/kisi-pi/src/pdn_ic.rs, package_of: 0201 < 0.65, 0402 < 1.25, 0603 < 1.95, 0805 < 2.7 mm), so KiCad's 0805 (pitch 1.9) is taken for an 0603 (README, kisi findings).
